title: Redeeming Reward Points Standing on a Circle Membership
content:
Points on a Northbeam Circle Membership are redeemed only while the membership stands active. The
standing recorded on the membership named, and the point balance standing on it, are what the desk reads
before a redemption is taken; a caller's account of the balance does not stand against the record.

## What a redemption is worth

The value of a redemption is the tier's value per hundred points applied to the points spent, rounded to
the nearest cent. A balance below one block of the tier's minimum redemption block cannot be redeemed at
all.

## What may never be done with points

Points may never be redeemed against dues, and they may never be paid out as cash.

## Points on a purchase that goes back

Points spent on a purchase that is then returned are restored to the balance as a fresh earning occasion,
not by deleting the redemption.

## Clauses of this policy no longer in force

Two clauses of this policy are **no longer in force**: the clause redeeming points in whole blocks of the
tier's minimum redemption block, and the clause allowing a redemption to be taken as a reward
certificate, as an instant discount at the till, as a donation to the retailer's recycling fund or, on the
tiers that allow it, as a transfer of points to another profile moving points at face value and earning
nothing. The minimum redemption block figure and the value per hundred points recorded for each tier
remain figures of the tier, and the clause on a balance below one block stays in force.

## Worked value of a redemption

On Circle Business Elite, whose value per hundred points is 1.25, a hypothetical redemption of 3200 points is
worth 40.00. On Circle Free Membership, whose value is 0.50 per hundred points, the same 3200 points are
worth 16.00. Where the tier's minimum block is 250 points and the balance stands at 180 points, nothing can
be redeemed, because the balance is below one block.

superseded_clauses: Points are redeemed in whole blocks of the tier's minimum redemption block

A redemption may be taken as a reward certificate, as an instant discount at the till, as a donation to the retailer's recycling fund, or, on the tiers that allow it, as a transfer of points to another profile; a transfer moves points at face value and earns nothing.
